training.rationale: identical to the v1.2 pilot (protocol v3) so the comparison isolates the dataset; LR is v3's stage-1 selection (not re-searched)

smoke.pass: bitwise A/B; corrupted and torn latest checkpoints rejected and rolled back to bitwise equality with A

candidate: the final checkpoint of seed 1 (j1-sft-v2-s1, update 1226); seeds 2 and 3 enter the acceptance rule; no checkpoint or seed is selected after scoring

baseline.description: replicated v1.2-recipe candidates (protocol v3 seed 1, replication v1 seeds 2 and 3) evaluated on this bundle with this scorer before the protocol was frozen; pairing by seed number

statistics.seed_aggregation: seed mean; per-seed exact McNemar against the same-seed baseline

primary.multiplicity: Holm over the endpoints (largest per-seed exact McNemar p per endpoint)
primary.pass: seed-mean improvement >= margin AND paired item-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND every seed improves on its same-seed baseline AND Holm-adjusted p < alpha

auto.formula: margin = max(0.03, 2 * sample SD of the three baseline seeds' accuracy on the group)

noninferiority.rule: PASS if the paired bootstrap CI lower bound of the seed-mean difference > -margin; FAIL if the CI upper bound < -margin or the point estimate < -margin; otherwise INSUFFICIENT

auto.formula: chat margin vs baseline = max(0.05, 2 * baseline seed SD on the relation)

knowledge.retention_view: each v2 seed's own few-shot answers vs the base's few-shot answers on the bundle's test facts items (exact McNemar per seed, Holm over relations); a relation fails retention only if every seed is significantly worse
knowledge.chat_view: chat facts non-inferior to the baseline seed mean by the auto margin

reported_not_gated: open-ended writing: blinded independent rubric review of seed-1 vs baseline seed-1 on the 21 test OASST1 prompts (unscored by the automatic scorer)

decision.note: a qualified research candidate is not a production release; the engineer does not promote it

rollback: juniper1-base-v1 remains canonical; every v2 run is a new lineage; all runs and rejected checkpoints preserved

budget.resources: 3 x RTX 4090 community ($0.34/h each at amendment), container disk only, no network volume
budget.timeouts: on-pod watchdog stops the pod after 150 min independent of the worker; the controller (this session) stops each pod after its outputs are pulled and verified
budget.reserve: stop and pull before the cap; never top up

dataset_note: j1-sft-v1.3 rebuilt after the independent admission review rejected manifest bf769ecd (never trained on)
registered_note: frozen before any v2 training run and before the v1.3-bundle baseline results; every baseline-dependent threshold is a formula below

sensitivity.classes: if_paraphrase: frame_only 195 / clean 87 / sibling_near 55 / same_op_near 63; if_composition_heldout: functional_trained 48 / unseen_function 252 (rebuild review N1/N2); reported, not gated

also_reported: chat abstention rate on answerable facts per seed (rebuild review condition)
open-ended writing: blinded independent rubric review of seed-1 vs baseline seed-1 outputs on the 21 test OASST1 prompts

environment.training_and_generation: RunPod RTX 4090 (community, 1 GPU per pod; secure single-GPU only as fallback within the cap), one pod per seed, image runpod/pytorch:1.0.2-cu1281-torch280-ubuntu2404 (torch 2.8.0+cu128, as on FLOWBOX), fp32, TF32 off, deterministic algorithms, CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8

environment.difference_recorded: training hardware differs from the baseline's; fp32 deterministic numerics differ across GPU types at rounding level only
